page_title: ROM 4-0 MON | AS Roma v Monza 24/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' That's the end of the match.

90+1' The free kick from the edge of the box is taken by Tomas Palacios (Monza), who fires in a direct effort inches over the crossbar. What a chance! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AS Roma.
90' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.

88' 4 - 0 Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) jumped highest to meet a perfectly executed corner kick by Paulo Dybala. His header was precise and ended up in the back of the net, leaving the goalkeeper flapping in the wind. The score is 4:0.
88' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) takes the corner.
88' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
86' Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
84' Kevin Martins (Monza) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Mile Svilar, who smothers the ball.
80' Angelino comes off the pitch to be replaced by Anass Salah-Eddine (AS Roma).
80' Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma) misses the left post by a whisker with a mid-range rebound. What a chance that was! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monza.
80' A lofted cross from Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
79' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Paulo Dybala (AS Roma), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
79' Tomas Palacios (Monza) commits a rough challenge and Fabio Maresca blows his whistle for an infringement. There is a free kick near the sideline to AS Roma.
76' Andrea Carboni is being substituted because of an injury. Alessandro Nesta sends Tomas Palacios (Monza) on the pitch.
76' Andrea Carboni (Monza) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

75' Andrea Carboni (Monza) misses a good chance to score. A perfect cross into the box finds Andrea Carboni (Monza) who rises for a header, but he sends the ball well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AS Roma.
75' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
75' The resulting corner from Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) comes to nothing. Now Monza have a corner.
73' 3 - 0 Goal! Bryan Cristante slips a clever pass through to Angelino (AS Roma), who moves inside the box and sends a measured shot beyond the keeper and into the bottom right corner. 3:0.
70' Claudio Ranieri has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Devyne Rensch (AS Roma) replacing Alexis Saelemaekers.
70' Substitution. Eldor Shomurodov makes way for Leandro Paredes (AS Roma).
69' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) finds space on the edge of the box, but his wild shot goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monza.
69' A pass by Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
68' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Keita Balde (Monza) replaces Dany Mota.
65' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Kevin Zeroli (Monza) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
64' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.
63' Fabio Maresca couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Dany Mota (Monza) and blew his whistle. AS Roma are awarded a free kick.
62' A substitution has been made. Tommaso Baldanzi goes off and Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) comes on.
62' A pass lands at the feet of Eldor Shomurodov (AS Roma) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.

60' Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma) bursts inside the box, beats two defenders and produces a strike from the penalty spot. The shot has power, but lacks precision and the goalkeeper stops it easily. The scoreline remains the same.
58' Matias Soule (AS Roma) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
58' Alessandro Bianco (Monza) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Fabio Maresca didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
56' Alessandro Nesta has decided to substitute Kacper Urbanski and he is replaced by Kevin Martins (Monza).
56' It will be a substitution. Kevin Zeroli (Monza) is ready to enter the pitch as Patrick Ciurria walks off.
55' Andrea Carboni (Monza) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle. A free kick has been awarded to AS Roma.
53' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Stefan Lekovic (Monza).
52' Patrick Ciurria (Monza) makes a rough challenge and Fabio Maresca blows his whistle for a foul. AS Roma get a free kick.
50' Fabio Maresca interrupts the game. One of the players from Monza won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. Free kick. AS Roma will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
50' Matias Soule (AS Roma) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
48' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Stefano Turati intercepts the ball.

47' A precise low pass is received by Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monza.
46' Half-time substitution. Alessandro Nesta decided to make a change. Silvere Ganvoula is replaced by Andrea Petagna (Monza).
46' Fabio Maresca blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.

45' Dany Mota (Monza) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the middle of the goal. Mile Svilar has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
44' Good movement by Patrick Ciurria (Monza), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
42' Monza fail to score from a corner as Mile Svilar (AS Roma) leaps to collect the ball.

42' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Silvere Ganvoula (Monza) inside the box. He lets fly towards the bottom left corner, but Mile Svilar was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save. The ball goes out of play and Monza have been awarded a corner kick.
41' Monza are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
39' Alexis Saelemaekers (AS Roma) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monza.
38' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Eldor Shomurodov (AS Roma) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
35' Eldor Shomurodov (AS Roma) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.

32' 2 - 0 Goal! Matias Soule hands Eldor Shomurodov (AS Roma) the simplest of tasks from close range after the cross evaded the keeper, and he makes no mistake with his header low into the middle of the goal. 2:0.

31' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) shows good awareness deep inside the box as he latches on to a cross from the resulting free kick. He jumps high but his towering header lacks accuracy and flies well over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Monza will have a goal kick.
30' Stefan Lekovic (Monza) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Fabio Maresca blows for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to AS Roma.

29' Andrea Carboni (Monza) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Fabio Maresca with no other option than to blow for a foul. AS Roma are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
27' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.

25' Great solo effort from Alexis Saelemaekers (AS Roma)! He beat a couple of players and shot from the edge of the box, but the effort slips just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Monza will have a goal kick.
24' Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
23' Matias Soule (AS Roma) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
22' Matias Soule (AS Roma) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
21' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Dany Mota (Monza) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
18' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Eldor Shomurodov (AS Roma) makes a good run into the box to meet a cross and fires the ball in on goal, but the shot is amazingly blocked by a defender.
18' Alessandro Bianco (Monza) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
18' Matias Soule (AS Roma) sends in the corner, but the keeper steps in and makes a save.
17' Eldor Shomurodov (AS Roma) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to AS Roma.
15' Matias Soule (AS Roma) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and fires in a shot that heads towards the middle of the goal, but Stefano Turati makes a comfortable save.
15' AS Roma quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
15' Angelino (AS Roma) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to AS Roma.
15' AS Roma will take a corner kick.

14' Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players. The ball goes out of play. AS Roma are awarded a corner kick.
12' Matias Soule (AS Roma) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.

10' 1 - 0 Goal! Eldor Shomurodov plays in Alexis Saelemaekers (AS Roma), who shows great determination to get to the ball before a couple of defenders and from inside the box he shoots into the left side of the net! Great finish - 1:0.
8' Alexis Saelemaekers (AS Roma) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.

7' Eldor Shomurodov (AS Roma) amazingly found his way through the defence, but lacked a precise finish as his effort from close range went slightly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Monza will have a goal kick.

5' Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monza.
5' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee. Monza are awarded the free kick.
3' AS Roma are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
2' Fabio Maresca blows his whistle after Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. Monza will take a free kick near the side line.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and AS Roma will have the kick-off.
Fabio Maresca is introduced as the referee for today's match.
